summary: Frontend E2E testing of Sync Multi-PC UI in v2.html BLOCKED by two critical bugs. Activation (MASTER key), Wizard, dashboard render, tabs regression (Copias/Contabilidad/Estadísticas/Utilidades/Configuración) and static pages (/panel-maestro.html, /admin.html HTTP 200) all work correctly. However, the actual Sync feature — the goal of this test — is 100% non-functional for MASTER users because (a) initSync() reads the wrong license field so window.mcSync never initializes, and (b) even after patching that, the backend /api/sync/status returns 404 for the MASTER key because it is not a real license in the DB. All Sync-related test cases (mode toggle, send backup, PC1↔PC2 flow, peers detection, pending backup) could NOT be executed end-to-end.

critical.issue: Returns HTTP 404 for MASTER key. The MASTER offline key is not registered as a real license in Mongo, so sync endpoints reject it. Multi-PC sync therefore cannot be exercised at all with the only test credential documented in /app/memory/test_credentials.md.

ui_bugs.issue: Guard reads lic.license_key which does NOT exist for MASTER license. saveLicense() at v2.html:9591 stores the MASTER key as lic.key (see stored payload: {"key":"MB-MASTER-BRUGULAT-2026-OWNER","type":"MASTER",...}). Because of the mismatch, initSync returns immediately, window.mcSync.init() is never called, cfg.apiBase stays null, and every subsequent call (getStatus, openSyncSettings, setMode, sendBackup) throws `TypeError: Cannot read properties of null (reading 'replace')` at sync-client.js:25. The top-bar badge shows '👑 Owner · Sin sync' as a visible symptom.
openSyncSettings() throws an unhandled exception when mcSync is not initialized, freezing the flow. Should either lazy-init or show a clear toast 'Sync unavailable' instead of crashing.

body.innerText length is only 88 chars — page appears near-empty (probably requires #token= fragment). Verify it renders meaningful content when opened via the '🎛️ Panel Licencias' button in the license modal.

integration_issues.issue: Cannot verify sync-btn-linked / sync-btn-independent / sync-send-backup toasts, mode switching, PC2 simulation, sendBackup, getPendingBackup — all blocked upstream by BUG #1 (client) and BUG #2 (backend 404 on MASTER key)

action_items: FIX #1 (client, 1-liner): In v2.html line 10731 change `if(!lic || !lic.license_key || !iid || !window.mcSync) return;` to accept either field, e.g. `const key = lic && (lic.license_key || lic.key); if(!key || !iid || !window.mcSync) return;` and pass `licenseKey: key` on line 10733. Aligns with how the rest of the file already reads `lic.key` (lines 10451, 10455, 10459, 10558). Without this fix Sync is dead for every MASTER user.

FIX #2 (backend or seeding): /api/sync/status must recognize MASTER key as premium (special-case it in sync router the same way isPremiumLicense() special-cases MB-MASTER-BRUGULAT-2026-OWNER on the client) OR seed a real PREMIUM license in the DB for testing and add it to /app/memory/test_credentials.md.
After #1 and #2 are fixed, retest full flow: modal open → sync-btn-linked toast → sync-btn-independent toast → PC2 simulation via localStorage swap → sendBackup on PC2 → getPendingBackup on PC1.
OPTIONAL (defensive): make openSyncSettings() detect uninitialized state and show a toast instead of throwing.
critical_code_review_comments: Naming inconsistency across v2.html: mcSync init uses `license_key`; sync heartbeat/push/pull at 10451/10455/10459 use `lic.key`. Standardize on one field name or always normalize in a single getter.
sync-client.js:25 `_url` blindly calls `.replace` on `cfg.apiBase` without null check; wrap in guard and throw a clear 'mcSync not initialized' error to make debugging faster.
v2.html is 10.8k lines — split into smaller modules (license, sync, config, contabilidad, estadísticas, utilidades). File >>700 lines guideline violated by ~15x.
Multiple 404s in console (5x) suggest missing static resources referenced but not present in /app/frontend/public/. Audit and clean up.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Two independent bugs block sync UI testing: (1) client-side field mismatch license_key vs key in initSync (v2.html:10731) → mcSync never initializes for MASTER; (2) backend /api/sync/status returns 404 for MASTER key. Reproduce via: activate MASTER on /v2.html → wizard EMPEZAR → open devtools → `await window.mcSync.getStatus()` throws. Patch demo: `const l=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('caja.license.v1'));l.license_key=l.key;localStorage.setItem('caja.license.v1',JSON.stringify(l));location.reload()` — after this, mcSync init runs but backend returns 404. Both must be fixed before UI flow (sync-btn-linked/independent/send-backup) can be exercised. Everything else in v2.html (activation, wizard, tabs, static pages panel-maestro.html and admin.html) works fine.
rca_of_the_issue: BUG #1 root cause: v2.html:9591 (`saveLicense({key: LIC.MASTER_KEY, type:'MASTER',...})`) stores the field as `key`, but the new Sync integration at v2.html:10731 (`if(!lic || !lic.license_key || !iid || !window.mcSync) return;`) reads `license_key`. Result: guard fails, `mcSync.init()` never runs, `cfg.apiBase` remains null, and later calls crash at sync-client.js:25 (`cfg.apiBase.replace(/\/$/,'')`). BUG #2 root cause: `/api/sync/status` endpoint validates license_key against the licenses collection in Mongo; the offline MASTER key is not persisted there, only special-cased client-side in isPremiumLicense(). Same special-case needs to be replicated on backend, or the test must use a real PREMIUM license generated via /api/licenses/generate.
